# GetRecruiters Group

> GetRecruiters Group, a division of NorthPoint Search Group (Atlanta, GA), provides dedicated virtual recruiters and places recruiters, sourcers, talent acquisition leaders, and HR professionals as temp, temp-to-perm, or direct hire. Demand is strongest for recruiters in data centers and mission-critical construction, the skilled trades, healthcare, public accounting, and financial services.

## Contact
- Phone: 404-250-0790 or 678-777-5627
- Email: gus@stafffinancial.com
- Get a recruiter: https://www.getrecruiters.com/request-talent.html
- Job board: https://host.pcrecruiter.net/pcrbin/jobboard.aspx?uid=Staff%20Financial.npsg

## Services
- Dedicated virtual recruiters: a full-time recruiting professional who works the client's openings as part of their team — sourcing (candidate database, major job boards, private LinkedIn groups), screening questionnaires, applicant video introductions, skills testing, reference and background check coordination, working inside the client's ATS. Priced on the recruiter's time, quoted up front.
- RPO and project recruiting: a recruiting team for a new data center, plant, or location, scaled up or down.
- Recruiter staffing: temp (bill rate per hour, GetRecruiters is Employer of Record), temp-to-perm (conversion fee agreed upfront), and direct hire (contingency, replacement guarantee).

## Roles placed
Data center and mission-critical recruiters, construction and skilled trades recruiters, healthcare recruiters, public accounting recruiters, financial services recruiters, technical/IT recruiters, executive recruiters, corporate and high-volume recruiters, sourcers, recruiting coordinators, talent acquisition managers and directors, heads of talent, recruiting operations, HR generalists, HR business partners, HR managers, and people operations.
